newsitem.title: TURKEY: Denktash invites new UN chief to Cyprus.
newsitem.headline: Denktash invites new UN chief to Cyprus.

text.p: Turkish Cypriot leader Rauf Denktash has invited newly-elected United Nations Secretary-General Kofi Annan to the divided island of Cyprus, the Turkish Cypriot news agency TAK said on Monday.
The agency said Denktash, president of the self-declared Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus, wanted to help Annan understand the Cyprus problem. It did not say when the invitation was sent.

Cyprus has been partitioned between Turkish and Greek Cypriot communities since Turkey invaded the island in 1974 in reaction to a coup in Nicosia engineered by the military government then ruling Greece.
The Turkish Cypriot Republic is recognized only by Turkey.
A small army of mediators, including U.N., U.S. and British representatives, has failed to make progress toward reuniting the island.
